$comment: The duty a row states, named once across every instrument that states it, so a reader sees one duty from six standards side by side (Demiton UX audit 2026-10-06). An obligation's `duty_shape` is a key here. A key reads `family.duty`, the first two segments of the obligation key that first stated it; rows that state the same duty under another key name this shape instead (NZS 3910's unforeseen conditions notice is `latent_conditions.notice`). Each value is the duty in a contractor's words.
approvals.aboriginal_heritage_find: Stop work and report an Aboriginal heritage find
approvals.aboriginal_heritage_harm: Do not harm Aboriginal cultural heritage without approval
approvals.aboriginal_heritage_plan_condi: Meet the conditions of the cultural heritage management plan
approvals.environmental_authority_condit: Meet every condition of the environmental authority
approvals.environmental_authority_incide: Notify the regulator of an environmental incident
approvals.environmental_authority_record: Keep the environmental authority's monitoring and incident records
approvals.vegetation_clearing_approval: Hold the approval before clearing native vegetation
approvals.vegetation_clearing_conditions: Meet the conditions of the clearing approval
approvals.vegetation_clearing_records: Keep the clearing approval and clearing records
approvals.waterway_barrier_approval: Hold the approval before building a waterway barrier
approvals.waterway_barrier_conditions: Meet the conditions of the waterway barrier approval
approvals.waterway_barrier_fish_passage: Keep fish passage open past a waterway barrier
clocs_a.client_reporting: Report CLOCS-A metrics to the client

clocs_a.speed_monitoring: Monitor heavy vehicle speed and give feedback
clocs_a.traffic_management_plan: Keep a construction traffic management plan
clocs_a.vehicle_safety_spec: Fit heavy vehicles with CLOCS-A safety equipment
closeout.defects_notification_period: Notify defects within the defects period

closeout.retention_regime_applicability: Work out which retention regime applies

counterparties.insurance_notification_no: Notify the insurer of a claim or circumstance

delay_eot.early_warning: Give early warning of a time or cost event

latent_conditions.unforeseen_conditions_: Give full details of a latent condition

tpar.annual_report: Lodge the taxable payments annual report
variations.day_works: Record day works on the day
variations.monthly_report: Report RFIs and change events monthly
variations.other_matter_notice: Notify any other matter affecting time or cost
variations.proposed_value: Propose the value of a variation
